enemy.name: Forest Wolf
enemy.description: A lean predator with bright eyes and an opinion about travelers.
enemy.defeat_text: The wolf gives one last ragged snarl before the forest path falls quiet again and the trees stop shivering around you.

enemy.name: Forest Bear
enemy.description: A broad bear drawn close to the road by panic, blood scent, and bad luck.
enemy.defeat_text: The bear crashes away through the brush, leaving broken branches and a safer path behind.

enemy.name: Forest Snake
enemy.description: A green-banded snake that vanishes under leaves until the path steps too close.
enemy.poison_text: The snake's bite leaves poison racing hot under your skin.
enemy.defeat_text: The snake coils once, then lies still among the roots.

enemy.name: Bandit Lookout
enemy.description: A nervous lookout posted among the stones to whistle if trouble arrives.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The lookout snaps a mirror charm in your eyes. Your next attack will falter.
enemy.defeat_text: The lookout drops the signal whistle and decides the ruins are no longer worth the pay.

enemy.name: Bandit Scout
enemy.description: A cutpurse with a short blade, fast feet, and no interest in fair fights.
enemy.defeat_text: The scout staggers back through the cracked stones, and the ruined courtyard feels less like an ambush and more like a road forward.

enemy.name: Bandit Raider
enemy.description: A hard-eyed raider with patched armor, a nicked blade, and no banner worth naming.
enemy.defeat_text: The raider drops back from the ruined stones, leaving the old approach a little less hungry.

enemy.name: Thorn Mantis
enemy.description: A green mantis plated in bark and briar, patient enough to become part of the scenery.
enemy.defeat_text: The mantis folds into the undergrowth, and the thorns loosen their grip on the path.

enemy.name: Root Hound
enemy.description: A hound-shaped knot of roots, moss, and bad old commands.
enemy.defeat_text: The root hound collapses into harmless vines that curl away from your boots.

enemy.name: Bramble Witch
enemy.description: A thornbound spirit that speaks through snapped twigs and borrowed birdsong.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The witch knots a briar around your weapon hand. Your next strike catches on thorns.
enemy.defeat_text: The bramble witch's borrowed voice scatters into startled birds.

enemy.name: Thorn Matriarch
enemy.description: The living queen of the Thornwild, crowned in emerald briars and old bloodless vows.
enemy.defeat_text: The Thorn Matriarch breaks like a storm-felled tree. At her roots, the Thorn Crown Relic opens its green thorns without cutting you.

boss_encounter.intro: The Matriarch rises from her throne, but the old green oaths still tremble beneath her anger. For one breath, violence is only one answer.
boss_encounter.fight: You draw steel and answer the Thornwild in its oldest language.
boss_encounter.bypass: You speak the names preserved in the elder's memory and show where the buried seeds have taken root. The Matriarch recognizes the repaired covenant and folds back into the living wood.
boss_encounter.control: The Heart Lantern opens like a green eye. Its light catches the Matriarch's crown and turns command into calm; she bows, then sinks beneath the roots to await a kinder age.

delay.label: Cut the throne-vines and run
delay.success_text: The throne-vines snap in the right order. The Matriarch lunges after the collapsing roots while you escape with what the briars leave behind. Somewhere deeper in the wood, something begins following your trail.
delay.failure_text: You cut the wrong vine. The throne recoils, the Matriarch surges free, and your clever delay becomes a very immediate fight.

enemy.name: Thorn Debt Stalker
enemy.description: A lean shape of burned briar and green eyes, grown from the debt left when the Thorn Matriarch was delayed rather than answered.
enemy.defeat_text: The stalker splits into dead vine and warm ash. The Thornwild's postponed anger has finally caught up, and finally ended.

enemy.name: Cinder Imp
enemy.description: A coal-eyed nuisance that throws sparks and laughs at smoke alarms.
enemy.defeat_text: The imp pops into a shower of harmless sparks.

enemy.name: Ash Hound
enemy.description: A charcoal hound with furnace breath and paws that leave glowing prints.
enemy.defeat_text: The ash hound's heat fades, leaving only black pawprints in the dust.

enemy.name: Ember Marauder
enemy.description: A raider in heat-scarred mail, paid to keep the mines burning wrong.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The marauder hurls ash into your eyes, spoiling your next attack.
enemy.defeat_text: The marauder drops a heat-cracked blade and retreats into the smoke.

enemy.name: Ember Colossus
enemy.description: A furnace giant built around the Emberheart Relic, each step ringing like an anvil struck by thunder.
enemy.defeat_text: The colossus kneels into a mountain of cooling slag. In its chest, the Emberheart Relic keeps burning for you.

enemy.name: Dune Wraith
enemy.description: A wind-thin ghost carrying the thirst of travelers who followed the wrong star.
enemy.defeat_text: The wraith unravels into sand that blows against the true road.

enemy.name: Glass Scorpion
enemy.description: A translucent scorpion whose venom glows like green fire under its shell.
enemy.poison_text: The scorpion's glass stinger leaves venom burning bright in your veins.
enemy.defeat_text: The scorpion shatters into harmless glass sand.

enemy.name: Mirage Bandit
enemy.description: A desert thief whose shadow moves a half-second before his body.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The bandit's mirror coin flashes, stealing your focus for a heartbeat.
enemy.defeat_text: The bandit's mirage double vanishes, leaving only one very tired outlaw.

enemy.name: Oasis Sphinx
enemy.description: A moon-eyed guardian whose wings are dusted with starlight and old riddles.
enemy.defeat_text: The Sphinx bows once, neither defeated nor ashamed, and the Mirage Orb Relic rolls from the pool into your waiting hands.

enemy.name: Script Golem
enemy.description: A hulking archive servant covered in commands no living librarian remembers writing.
enemy.defeat_text: The golem's script rearranges into an apology before fading from its clay skin.

enemy.name: Ink Stalker
enemy.description: A predator made of spilled black ink and marginal notes with teeth.
enemy.defeat_text: The stalker splashes across the floor and drains harmlessly into the cracks.

enemy.name: Lunar Shade
enemy.description: A pale reflection of an archivist who chose to become a warning.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The shade recites your next motion before you make it, ruining the attack.
enemy.defeat_text: The shade lets out a relieved sigh and becomes ordinary moonlight.

enemy.name: Moonfall Warden
enemy.description: The last warden of the fallen archive, carrying the Moonfall Relic where its heart should be.
enemy.defeat_text: The warden lowers its blade and finally closes eyes it never had. The Moonfall Relic settles into your palm, cold and clear.

enemy.name: Void Thrall
enemy.description: A citadel servant hollowed out by starless commands.
enemy.defeat_text: The thrall collapses, and a little stolen starlight escapes through its ribs.

enemy.name: Starless Knight
enemy.description: A knight-shaped absence wearing armor that reflects no torchlight.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The knight's empty helm turns toward you, and your next attack dies in your hands.
enemy.defeat_text: The knight falls without a sound, armor folding around nothing at all.

enemy.name: Abyss Serpent
enemy.description: A black-scaled serpent swimming through air as if the world were deep water.
enemy.poison_text: The serpent's bite leaves cold poison spreading through your blood.
enemy.defeat_text: The serpent dissolves into a ribbon of night and vanishes under the stones.

enemy.name: Arcane Sentinel
enemy.description: A towering relic guardian of bronze ribs and blue-white moonfire, built to bar the final truths from unproven hands.
enemy.defeat_text: The sentinel collapses in rings of moonfire, and the old vault yields a silence heavy enough to feel like permission.

enemy.name: Concord Wyrm
enemy.description: The ancient hunger beneath the relics, a dragon of void, thorn, ember, mirage, and moonlight forced into one impossible body.
enemy.prevent_attack_text: The Concord Wyrm speaks all four relic names at once, staggering your focus.
enemy.poison_text: The wyrm's void-breath leaves a poison colder than winter in your lungs.
enemy.defeat_text: The Concord Wyrm tears itself apart along the seams of the four relics. For the first time in centuries, Emerald Keep's heart beats without fear.
